title: Addition of 3-Digit Numbers

key_big: Add units, then tens, then hundreds
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Write the numbers in columns: hundreds under hundreds, tens under tens, units under units.
  • Start with the units. If the units make 10 or more, carry 1 ten to the tens column.
  • Do the same for the tens: 10 tens make 1 hundred.

Examples

Example

348 + 275

8 + 5 = 13, write 3 carry 1

4 + 7 + 1 = 12, write 2 carry 1

3 + 2 + 1 = 6

Answer: 623

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting to carryWrite the carried 1 above the next column.
Starting from the leftAlways start with the units.
Not lining up the numbersUnits under units.
